2. Test the CodeQL ignore glob

In a CodeQL glob, * matches inside one path segment and ** matches any number of segments. On main before this PR, 320 of the 334 top-level directories under docs/ match (this PR adds its own playground, making it 321 of 335). The other 14, and all of docs/site (including public/lab), stay scanned.

The PR merge ref analysis (CodeQL and zizmor) reported 0 results, and none of these 20 alerts has an instance there. CodeQL on a pull request is diff-informed, so that proves the changed files only. The 5 "still open" rows are the expected state after merge, not a measured one.
